name: kytrade
description: Operate kytrade, Kyle's personal trading toolkit: bootstrap and health-check the stack, pull daily stock prices, manage S&P 500 and TSX 60 membership, track ETFs (SPY, QQQ, XIU.TO), and answer market questions (performance, comparisons, movers, sectors, 52-week screeners, volatility) from its Postgres document store via the kt CLI or FastAPI ingress.
